description: This source file implements the DownstreamSenderFactoryImpl class, which is responsible for creating and managing downstream sender instances for telemetry and event data within the Eclipse Hono client framework. It handles connection checks, caching, and cleanup of sender objects, integrating with Vert.x event bus and connection management.

classes.name: DownstreamSenderFactoryImpl
classes.description: A factory class for creating and managing downstream sender instances, ensuring proper connection handling and client caching within the Hono client framework.

methods.name: DownstreamSenderFactoryImpl
methods.description: Constructor initializing the factory with a HonoConnection and setting up event bus consumer for tenant timeout events.

methods.name: onDisconnect
methods.description: Handles cleanup actions when disconnection occurs, clearing cached clients.

methods.name: getOrCreateTelemetrySender
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a cached telemetry sender for a specified tenant, ensuring connection availability.

methods.name: getOrCreateEventSender
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a cached event sender for a specified tenant, ensuring connection availability.

methods.name: handleTenantTimeout
methods.description: Handles tenant timeout messages by closing and removing associated downstream sender clients.
